DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。展示について何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with the exhibit?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 祖父の家に、この展示品に似た木の道具があります。同じ物かは分かりませんが、帰ってから比べるため何をメモすればよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 祖父の道具に似た展示を家で比べるためメモする項目を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: My grandfather has a wooden tool at home that resembles this exhibit. I don't know whether it's the same, but what should I note to compare them after returning home?
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese which details to note for comparing an exhibit resembling your grandfather's tool at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 展示名と説明にある用途を控えられます。ご自宅の物の写真や寸法はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can note the exhibit name and stated use. Do you have photographs or measurements of the item at home?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真はありますが、長さは測っていません。形が似ているだけで、展示と同じ用途だったとは決めないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真はあるが寸法なしで形の類似だけから用途を断定しないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: A photo, but I haven't measured its length. I don't want to conclude it had the same use just because the shape is similar.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have a photo but no dimensions and won't infer the same use from shape alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 取っ手や穴の位置など、見える特徴を比べる手掛かりにできます。説明文をそのまま全部写すのが目的ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: Visible features such as handle and hole positions can help comparisons. Is your aim to copy the entire explanation word for word?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ、家の道具を調べる時の質問を作りたいです。「取っ手がどこにあるか」「穴が何個あるか」を、自分で確認する項目にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明全文の転記でなく取っ手と穴を調べる自分用質問を作ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: No, I'd like to make questions for examining the tool at home. I'll make my own checklist: where is the handle, and how many holes are there?
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want personal questions about handles and holes rather than copying the entire description.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 展示名は「木製の糸巻き」です。ここでは、この展示品の説明としてお読みください。ご自宅の物の鑑定を行ったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: The exhibit is called a “wooden thread reel.” Read that as this exhibit's description; we haven't identified your item at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 展示名も控えますが、家の物の名前としてすぐ家族へ伝えません。長さを測り、別の角度の写真も撮ってから、祖父に使い方を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 木製糸巻きは展示名として控え家の物と断定せず寸法写真と祖父の話を調べると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll note the exhibit name, but won't immediately tell family it's our item's name. I'll measure its length, photograph other angles and then ask my grandfather how it was used.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will note “wooden thread reel” as the exhibit name, not identify the home item, and check dimensions, photos and your grandfather's account.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 詳しく調べる時は、写真だけで用途を決めず、専門の相談先も探してみてください。展示の前で長く止まらず、メモは休憩場所でも整理できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: For detailed research, don't determine use from photos alone; look for a specialist advice contact too. Rather than stopping long before the exhibit, you can organize notes at a rest area.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 取っ手と穴の位置を短く記録して、休憩場所で質問をまとめます。展示を家の道具を調べるきっかけとして使います。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 特徴を短く控え休憩場所で質問をまとめ自宅調査のきっかけにすると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll briefly record the handle and hole positions, then organize questions at the rest area. I'll use the exhibit as a starting point for researching the home tool. Thank you.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will briefly note features and organize questions at a rest area as a starting point for home research.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 展示とご自宅の物を区別して確認する形ですね。どうぞ引き続き展示をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: You'll check while distinguishing the exhibit from your home item, then. Please continue enjoying the exhibition.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。商店街で何かお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you looking for something in the shopping street?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と買物に来ましたが、雨が強くなりました。重い調理器具を先に買って歩き回るより、店を回る順番を考え直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雨の中で重い器具を先に持たず買物の店順を組み直したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came shopping with a friend, but the rain has become heavy. Rather than buy heavy kitchen equipment first and carry it around, I'd like to rethink our shop order.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to rearrange shop order so you don't carry heavy equipment first in the rain.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日はどのお店へ行く予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which shops do you plan to visit today?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 調理器具の店と本屋です。器具の店は入口の近くで、本屋は奥にあります。最後は入口から帰るので、本屋を先にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口付近の器具店を帰りにし奥の本屋を先にする希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: The kitchenware shop and bookstore. Kitchenware is near the entrance and books are farther in. Since we leave by the entrance, I'd like the bookstore first.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want the deeper bookstore first and the entrance kitchenware shop on return.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その順なら、帰り道に器具の店へ寄れます。本屋までは屋根のある右側の通りを進めますが、途中で一度道路を渡ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that order, you can stop at kitchenware on your way out. The covered street on the right leads to the bookstore, but you cross a road once along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右の通りから本屋へ行き、道路を渡る所では傘で周りが見えなくならないようにします。友人にも順番を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 右の屋根付き通りと道路横断を確認し友人にも順番を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: We'll take the right-hand street and avoid letting our umbrellas block our view at the road crossing. I'll tell my friend the order too.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese the covered right-hand street and road crossing and say you will tell your friend the order.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 器具を買うかは、重さや持ち帰り方をお店でご確認ください。お車へ戻る予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: At the shop, check the weight and carrying method before deciding on equipment. Are you returning to a car?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 徒歩で駅へ戻ります。二人で持てば大丈夫と決めず、箱の大きさを見て、今日は買わない選択も残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 駅へ徒歩で戻るため箱の大きさを見て器具を買わない選択も残すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'll walk to the station. I won't assume two people can manage it; we'll look at the box size and keep not buying today as an option.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you return to the station on foot and will check the box size, retaining the option not to buy equipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。本屋は奥の青い看板が目印です。閉店まで一時間あるので、必要な物を絞って回ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. The bookstore's landmark is the blue sign farther in. There is an hour until closing, so narrow down what you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 青い看板へ向かい、本屋の後に入口の器具店へ寄ります。器具を買うかは持ち帰りを確認してから二人で決めます。案内ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 青看板の本屋から入口器具店へ回り持ち帰り確認後二人で購入判断すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll head for the blue sign, then visit kitchenware at the entrance after the bookstore. We'll both decide on buying after checking how to carry it home. Thank you.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese the blue-sign bookstore then entrance kitchenware, and deciding together after checking transport.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 回る順番と持ち帰りの確認ですね。雨の中ですので、足元に気を付けてお買物ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: The visit order and carrying check, then. It's rainy, so watch your step while shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。展示をご覧になって、何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you after looking at the exhibit?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもと木の実の形を描きましたが、名前をまだ書いていません。先に自分たちで見た特徴を残してから、展示の説明と比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子と描いた木の実へ命名前に観察特徴を残して説明と比べたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child and I drew a tree nut, but haven't written its name yet. We'd like to first record the features we noticed ourselves, then compare with the exhibit explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that before naming the nut you drew with your child, you want to record observations and compare the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの展示の木の実を描きましたか。絵や展示番号で示していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which exhibit's nut did you draw? Could you indicate it with the drawing or exhibit number?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この三番の展示です。丸い形と表面の線を描きました。子どもが気付いたことを、名前を聞く前に横へ書き足したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三番の丸さと表面線を描き子が気付いた点を先に追記したいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: This exhibit three. We drew its round shape and surface lines. I'd like to add what my child noticed before hearing the name.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out exhibit three's roundness and lines and say in Japanese that you want to add your child's observations first.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 観察した特徴を残すのですね。名称の説明は、展示の左側にあります。今はそれを隠したり外したりする必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: You'll keep the observed features, then. The name explanation is on the left of the exhibit. You don't need to cover or remove it now.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 表示には触りません。少し離れた机で「丸い」「線がある」とメモしてから戻ります。分からない特徴を想像で増やしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表示には触らず机で見た二特徴だけメモし想像で増やさないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: We won't touch the sign. We'll note “round” and “has lines” at a table a little away, then return. We won't invent extra features we don't know.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not touch the sign and will note only the two observed features at a table, not add imagined ones.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの机を使えます。名前を調べた後も、最初のメモは消さずに残しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can use this table. After finding the name, will you keep the initial notes without erasing them too?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、観察のメモと調べた名前を別の色で書きます。名前が分かっても、家の近くの木の実まで同じ種類だとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最初の観察と名称を別色にし家付近の実を同種と決めないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, we'll write observations and the researched name in different colors. Even knowing the name, we won't decide nuts near home are the same kind.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that initial observations and the name use separate colors and do not identify nuts near home as the same species.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: いい方法ですね。この三番の名称は「クルミ」です。お戻りになったら、説明板でも同じ展示番号をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's a good way. Exhibit three's name is “walnut.” When returning, check the same exhibit number on the explanation panel too.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 観察は鉛筆、名前は青で書きます。三番のクルミという表示と比べ、ほかの木の実との違いも後で見たいです。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 観察鉛筆と名前青を分け三番クルミの説明と比べ他種の違いも見たいと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll use pencil for observations and blue for the name. We'll compare with exhibit three's walnut label and later look at differences from other nuts too. Thank you.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese pencil observations versus blue name, comparison with walnut exhibit three and interest in other species' differences.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 観察した記録を残しながら名称を調べる形ですね。お子様と展示をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: You'll find the name while preserving observations, then. Enjoy the exhibit with your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。駅のご利用についてお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with using the station?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来月、この臨時駅で降りて友人と散策したいです。日程を決める前に、何をそろえて運行の確認をすればよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 来月臨時駅で降りる散策の日程前に運行確認へ必要な情報を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: Next month I'd like to get off at this seasonal station and walk with a friend. Before deciding the date, what information should I gather to check services?
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese what information is needed to check service before scheduling next month's walk from a seasonal station.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 臨時駅なので、利用する日と列車の方向を確認する必要があります。候補日は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: Because it's seasonal, we need to check the day and train direction. Have you chosen candidate dates?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 来月の第一土曜か翌日の日曜です。まだ宿も予約していません。日付が決まる前に、どちらの日に利用できるか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 第一土曜と翌日日曜の二候補で宿未予約と日付決定前の確認希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: The first Saturday next month or the Sunday after. I haven't booked accommodation. Before finalizing the date, I'd like to check which day it can be used.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have two candidates, first Saturday and following Sunday, no lodging booking, and want confirmation before deciding.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その二日を具体的な日付にして、運行案内へお問い合わせください。行きはどちらの方面から来ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: Turn those two days into specific dates and contact service information. Which direction will you arrive from?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水戸方面から来ます。帰りも同じ方面へ戻りたいので、降りられる便だけでなく帰りに乗れる便も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 水戸方面から来て同じ方向へ戻るため行き停車と帰り乗車の両方を確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: From Mito. I'd like to return the same way, so I'll check not only services I can get off but also return services I can board.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will come from and return toward Mito and check both outward stops and return boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 往復の方向と候補日をまとめるのですね。お問い合わせ先はこの運行案内です。ここでは来月の停車を確約できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: You'll organize both directions and candidate dates, then. This is the service-information contact. We cannot guarantee next month's stops here.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の案内だけで予定表に「利用可能」と書かず、返答を待ちます。どちらも使えなければ、通常の駅からの行き方を別に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 停車確約でないと理解し返答を待ち両日不可なら通常駅からの経路を別相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't mark “available” in the plan just from this guidance; I'll await the reply. If neither day works, I'll separately ask about a route from a regular station.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand stops are not guaranteed, will wait for a reply, and ask about a normal-station route if both days are unavailable.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その場合に備えて、散策の集合場所もご友人と相談してください。駅だけを先に集合先として固定しない方が調整しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: To prepare for that, discuss the walking meeting point with your friend too. Avoiding fixing only the station in advance makes adjustments easier.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの候補日と往復の方向をメモして問い合わせます。友人には駅利用を確認中と伝え、集合場所も返答後に決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 具体的二日と往復を問い合わせ友人に確認中と伝え集合先は返答後に決めると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note the two candidate dates and directions and ask. I'll tell my friend station use is being checked and decide the meeting point after the response too.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will inquire with two exact dates and return directions, tell your friend it is unconfirmed, and decide the meeting point after the reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 候補日と往復を確認してから計画する形ですね。運行案内の返答をお待ちください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: You'll plan after checking dates and both directions, then. Please await the service-information response. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お菓子選びをお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. May I help you choose sweets?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人とあん菓子を一つずつ食べたいです。友人は粒の食感が気になるそうなので、粒あんとこしあんを少量で比べられる物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人と粒あんの食感を比べるため粒あんとこしあんを少量で選べる物を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend and I want one bean-paste sweet each. My friend is concerned about the texture of pieces; is there something small to compare chunky and smooth bean paste?
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for small chunky- and smooth-bean-paste choices to compare textures with your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 小さなおまんじゅうが一個ずつあります。粒あんは一個百二十円、こしあんは百三十円です。どちらを何個になさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have individual small manju buns. Chunky paste is 120 yen each and smooth paste 130. Which and how many would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まず粒あんとこしあんを一個ずつにします。私が粒あん、友人がこしあんを食べ、それぞれ感じた食感を話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 粒あんとこしあん各一個で自分は粒あん友人はこしあんを食べ感想を話すと指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: First, one of each. I'll eat chunky and my friend smooth, and we'd like to discuss the texture each feels.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify in Japanese one chunky for you and one smooth for your friend so you can discuss impressions.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二種類一個ずつですね。今お召し上がりになりますか。持ち帰り用の箱にも入れられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: One of each type, then. Are you eating now? We can also put them in a takeaway box.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この二個は今いただきます。気に入った物をあとで買うかは、食べてから決めます。最初から持帰り分まで頼むつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二個は店内で食べ持帰り追加は味を確かめてから判断すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: We'll eat these two now. We'll decide after eating whether to buy something we like later. We don't intend to order takeaway portions from the start.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the two are for eating here and you will decide any takeaway additions after tasting.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 店内用の皿を別々にご用意します。温かいお茶は一杯二百円です。ご一緒にいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll prepare separate plates for eating here. Warm tea is 200 yen a cup. Would you like some too?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お茶は私だけ一杯お願いします。友人には自分で選んでもらいます。今の注文は菓子二個とお茶一杯で、合計四百五十円ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 茶は自分のみ一杯を選び菓子二個と茶で四百五十円と計算する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: One tea just for me, please. I'll let my friend choose for themselves. The current order is two sweets and one tea, 450 yen total, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose only your own one tea in Japanese and calculate two sweets plus tea as 450 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、四百五十円です。お菓子を召し上がった後の追加は、改めてお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, 450 yen. Please tell us separately about additions after eating the sweets.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二個とお茶一杯でお願いします。今日は食べ比べだけにして、持帰りは追加しません。友人と少量ずつ選べてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は二個と茶一杯の食べ比べのみで持帰り追加なしと注文を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: Two sweets and one tea, please. Today we'll only compare them and won't add takeaway. I'm glad we could each choose a small amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Finalize in Japanese today's two-sweet and one-tea tasting order with no takeaway additions.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 粒あんとこしあんを一個ずつ、お茶を一杯承りました。どうぞお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: One chunky-paste bun, one smooth-paste bun and one tea. Please enjoy.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お疲れさまです。現場で何か相談したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Thank you for your work. Is there anything on site you'd like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 共有の巻尺を探して、作業の前に待つことが何度かありました。道具を増やす前に、戻す場所の決め方を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 共有巻尺を探す待ち時間があり増設前に返却場所の決め方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: Several times I've had to wait before work while looking for the shared tape measure. Before adding more tools, I'd like to discuss deciding a return location.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about a return location before buying more shared tape measures because searching causes waiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 探すことが多いのは、いつですか。どこで見つかったかも分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: When do you often look for it? Do you know where it was found?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今週は朝の準備で三回ありました。二回は机、一回は別の道具箱で見つかりました。誰が悪いと決めるためでなく、場所が散らばる点を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今週朝に三回探し机二回と別箱一回で個人非難でなく置場の分散を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: Three times during morning preparation this week. Twice on a desk and once in another toolbox. I'm not trying to decide whose fault it was, but point out the scattered locations.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese three morning searches this week, two desk finds and one other box, as scattered storage rather than blaming individuals.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 時間と見つかった場所を記録して、置き場の責任者へ提案できます。どのような案を考えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can record the times and found locations and propose to the storage supervisor. What idea do you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 返す場所を一か所決めて、巻尺の名前を表示する案です。ただ、通路の近くに勝手に箱を置くのではなく、責任者に場所を確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返却一か所と名前表示を提案し通路へ勝手に箱を置かず責任者に位置確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: One return location with the tape measure's name displayed. But rather than place a box near the passage myself, I'd like the supervisor to check the location.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Propose one labelled return location in Japanese and ask for supervisor approval rather than placing a box in the passage yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 置く位置は責任者が確認します。表示だけで解決すると決めず、使っている人が持ったままの場合も考えられますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: The supervisor will check the position. Rather than assume a label solves everything, we should also consider someone still using it.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、使っている時と戻し忘れた時を区別したいです。名前の表示に加えて、持ち出していることが分かる方法も相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 使用中と返却忘れを区別するため持出しが分かる方法も相談すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I'd like to distinguish in-use from forgotten returns. Along with the name label, I'll discuss a method showing it has been taken out.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want checkout visibility to distinguish use from forgotten returns.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その二つを短い提案としてまとめてください。今日は共有の道具箱を、ご自身の判断で移動させないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please summarize those two ideas in a short proposal. Don't move the shared toolbox on your own judgment today.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三回の時間と見つかった場所、返却場所の表示と持出しが分かる案をまとめます。今の箱は動かさず、責任者へ提案を見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三回の時刻発見場所と表示案をまとめ箱を動かさず責任者へ提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll summarize the three times and found locations and the ideas for a return label and checkout display. I won't move the current box; I'll show the supervisor the proposal.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will organize the three times, places and display proposal without moving the box and present it to the supervisor.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記録を基にした置き場と持出し表示の相談ですね。責任者へ提案を引き継ぎます。気付きを伝えていただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: A record-based inquiry about storage and checkout display, then. I'll pass the proposal to the supervisor. Thank you for sharing your observation.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 娘の就職祝いに、お金を贈ろうと思っています。すぐ使う現金ではなく貯金にする案もありますが、本人に聞く前に商品を決めてよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 娘の就職祝いを貯金にする案だが本人へ聞く前に商品を決めるか迷うと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to give money to celebrate my daughter starting work. Savings rather than immediately usable cash is one idea, but I'm unsure about choosing a product before asking her.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about making your daughter's job-start gift savings, without choosing a product before asking her.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お嬢様は今日、ご一緒ではありませんね。贈る目的や、本人の使いたい時期についてはお話しされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your daughter isn't with you today, correct? Have you discussed the gift's purpose and when she wants to use it?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ話していません。引越しに使うかもしれないので、私が長く使えない形を決めるより、本人の予定を先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 娘と未相談で引越しに使う可能性があり長期制限を親だけで決めず先に予定を聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. She may use it for moving, so I'd like to ask her plans first rather than decide myself on something inaccessible for a long time.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not asked your daughter, she may need moving costs, and you will hear her plans before imposing long restrictions.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使う時期や希望を聞いた後に、必要な手続きと商品の条件を相談できます。今日、お嬢様名義の手続きを進めるご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: After hearing her timing and wishes, you can discuss required procedures and product conditions. Do you want to proceed today in her name?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ、今日は進めません。親だから本人の手続きをすべて代わりにできるとは思わず、次回必要な物も改めて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日は娘名義手続きを進めず親だから代理で全て可能と決めず次回必要物を確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: No, not today. I won't assume being her parent means I can do all her procedures for her; I'll also check again what is needed next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not proceed in your daughter's name today or assume parental authority allows everything, and will check next-time requirements.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。贈ることのお話と、商品の契約は別にお考えください。お嬢様と相談する時に聞きたい条件はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Consider the gift discussion separately from a product contract. Are there conditions you want to ask about when talking with her?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 使える時期と、途中で必要になった場合の条件を知りたいです。利息の数字だけで選ばず、娘が引越し費用に使いたいかも聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利息だけでなく使用時期と途中で必要な場合の条件及び娘の引越し用途を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: When she can use it, and conditions if she needs it partway through. I won't choose only by interest figures, and will ask whether she wants it for moving expenses.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want availability timing, early-need conditions and your daughter's moving plans considered beyond interest alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点を整理して、具体的な商品を検討する際にお尋ねください。本日は商品の選択や申込みはしない形でよろしいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: Organize those points and ask when considering specific products. Today you will not choose or apply for a product, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、娘の予定を聞いてから、二人で相談するか決めます。贈りたい気持ちだけで今日契約せず、聞きたい条件を持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 娘の予定を聞き二人で相談するか決め今日は申込まず条件を持ち帰ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: Correct. After hearing her plans, we'll decide whether to consult together. I won't contract today just from wanting to give a gift; I'll take the condition questions home.
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that after asking your daughter you will decide on a joint consultation, not apply today and take the conditions home.

DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本人の予定と条件を確認してから検討する相談で承りました。本日は申込みを行いません。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-008-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've noted a consultation on considering options after checking her plans and conditions. No application will be made today. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。切符のどの表示を確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Which display on the ticket would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ここに四号車とあります。四番線へ行こうとしましたが、発車案内では二番線でした。乗る場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 四号車と四番線を混同した乗場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says car four here. I was going to platform four, but the departure board says platform two. Please tell me where to board.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese where to board after confusing car four with platform four.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この切符の列車名と、発車案内の列車名は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the train name on this ticket the same as on the departure board?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、十八時十分の同じ列車です。列車は合っていますが、四という数字の意味を混ぜました。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 列車名時刻は一致し番号の種類を混ぜたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the same 18:10 train. The train is right, but I mixed up what the number four means.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the train name and time match but you confused the number types.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二番線がホームの番号で、四号車は列車の中の車両番号です。二番線では足元の四号車表示を探してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Two is the platform number, while four is the car number within the train. On platform two, look for the car-four marking at your feet.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二番線へ行ってから四号車の位置を探すのですね。友人には四番線と伝えたので、先に訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二番線から四号車位置へ進む順を復唱し友人への訂正を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I go to platform two and then look for car four. I told my friend platform four, so I'll correct it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Repeat in Japanese the order of platform two then car four and say you will correct the information given to your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お友達は、もう別のホームへ行かれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Has your friend already gone to another platform?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。改札の横にいるので、二番線で会って一緒に四号車の表示を確認すると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: まだ改札にいる友人と二番線で合流する予定を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. They're beside the gates, so I'll say to meet on platform two and check the car-four marking together.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your friend is still at the gates and you will meet on platform two.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 切符はお二人ともご自身でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please each keep your own ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。友人にも訂正できました。二番線の列車名と時刻を見て、各自の号車と席を確認して乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正済みの案内と各自の号車席を確認して乗ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I've corrected my friend too. We'll check the train name and time on platform two, then each person's car and seat before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the correction is done and you will verify the guidance plus each car and seat before boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二番線への案内はこちらです。お気を付けてどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The directions to platform two are here. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 写真を撮りましょうか。お連れの方もいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall I take a photograph? Are you here with companions?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。友人が二人来るので、全員そろってから撮っていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人二人が来るまで撮影を待ってもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please. Two friends are coming; could you take it once everyone is here?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the photograph to wait until two friends arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 大丈夫ですよ。お友達は、ここが分かりそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Of course. Will your friends know where this is?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一人が反対側にいるようです。像の写真を送って、こちらに来てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 反対側にいる友人へ像の写真を送ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: One seems to be on the opposite side. I'll send a photograph of the statue and ask them to come here.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will send a statue photograph to your friend on the opposite side.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今立っている所だと、後ろを通る方にぶつかりそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Where you're standing now, you might collide with people passing behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、少し横で待ちます。撮るときだけ像の前に並んでもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通行を避けて待ち撮影時の立ち位置を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then we'll wait a little to the side. May we line up before the statue only when taking the photo?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait clear of traffic and ask about the position during the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 人が途切れたときにしましょう。縦と横、どちらで撮りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's do it when there is a gap in people. Would you like portrait or landscape?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 横でお願いします。像も入れたいですが、友人の顔が小さくなりすぎないようにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 横向きで像と顔を収める構図を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Landscape, please. We'd like the statue included, but could you avoid making my friends' faces too small?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for landscape framing with both the statue and faces.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この位置なら両方入ります。皆さんそろいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: From this position, both fit. Is everyone here?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、そろいました。このスマホで一枚お願いします。荷物は自分たちで持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全員の到着を知らせスマホを渡して撮影を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, we're all here. One photo with this phone, please. We'll hold our own belongings.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that everyone arrived, hand over the phone and ask for the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。皆さん、こちらを見てください。撮りますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Everyone, look here please. I'm taking it now.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 御朱印帳をお持ちですか。ご希望のページをお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a goshuin seal book? Please show the page you want.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。このページにお願いしたいです。まだ空いていると思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 御朱印帳を出し希望のページを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like this page, please. I think it's still blank.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Present the seal book and indicate the desired page in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここには紙が挟んでありますが、取り出してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: There's a sheet tucked here; may I remove it?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あ、それは前に頂いた書き置きです。まだ貼っていませんでした。そのページは残しておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 挟まった書き置きに気づきそのページを残したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Oh, that's a prewritten seal sheet I received before. I hadn't pasted it yet. I'd like to keep that page for it.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you noticed the tucked prewritten sheet and want to reserve that page.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、別のページにしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then shall we use another page?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。一つ後ろの空いているページに変えてください。先ほどの紙は自分で持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一つ後ろの空きページへ変更し紙は自分で持つと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. Change to the next blank page after it. I'll hold the earlier sheet myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to change to the next blank page and say you will hold the sheet yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらのページですね。お預かりしてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: This page, correct? May we take the book?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。出来上がるまで境内を見ていたいのですが、受け取りの場所はここですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 預けることに同意し境内を見ている間の受取場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'd like to look around the grounds until it's ready; is collection here?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Agree in Japanese to leave the book and ask the collection place while you visit the grounds.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらでお受け取りください。控えをお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please collect it here. I'll give you a receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。控えを持って戻ります。友人が先に戻ったら、私が受け取るまでここで待ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えを持って戻り友人にも受取まで待ってもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll return with the receipt. If my friend returns first, I'll ask them to wait here until I collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will return with the receipt and ask your friend to wait until collection.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、変更したこちらのページでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll take it for the revised page here.
